value.answer: This sounds like a common toddler stomach bug (viral gastroenteritis) causing loose, watery diarrhea and vomiting. Drinking well and wet diapers are great signs. Keep offering small, frequent sips of fluid rather than big amounts, and it should ease over a few days.
value.triage: Call 811 if it drags past a couple more days, diapers drop below 3/day, mouth looks dry, or fluids won't stay down. Go to the ER or call 911 now if no urine for 8+ hours, sunken eyes, non-stop vomiting, blood in stool/vomit, severe belly pain, or unusual drowsiness.
